description:
Free local tool. Removes expired memories and memories with relevance below threshold after decay. Also archives tool call records older than retention period. No x402 charge.

SAP MCP execution guidance: Intent: SAP MCP tool workflow. Pricing: free; call directly without x402. Routing: free hosted call; call directly and keep it small/exact when possible. Signer boundary: hosted reads/builders never receive keypair bytes; value-moving results must be finalized locally when signing is required.

inputSchema.description: Prune Old Memories input schema. Intent: SAP MCP tool workflow. Pricing: free; call directly without x402. Routing: free hosted call; call directly and keep it small/exact when possible. Signer boundary: hosted reads/builders never receive keypair bytes; value-moving results must be finalized locally when signing is required. Use exact field names from this schema; do not guess aliases or include private key material.

archiveDays.description: Archive tool calls older than N days. Default 90.

minRelevance.description: Minimum decayed relevance to keep. Default 0.05.
